title: Replication package: When Projects Declare What Blame Should Ignore: Effects on Line-Based Ownership Measures
description: Replication package for a census of 435 GitHub repositories with at least 5,000 stars that keep a .git-blame-ignore-revs file. It contains the sampling frame, the measurement and analysis scripts, the per-repository measurement records with hashed developer identities, and the script that regenerates every number, table, and figure of the article.
